notes: בְּיוֹם רִדְתּוֹ: the preposition stands on יוֹם, so the when falls to the infinitive as nomen rectum under rule 52's closing clause and rule 19, and the suffix takes the subject he.
Both causatives, הֶאֱבַלְתִּי and אַקְדִּר, are headed on their complements under rule 44.
The directive he of שְׁאוֹלָה takes the written to (rule 32), the host name keeping Sheol.
